units.source_text: 开始，与其说是梦，不如说是介于梦和现实之间，

en.t: At first, it was less a dream than something between dream and reality,

units.source_text: 她非常高兴地回想起了今天和真砂子到北山杉村去的情景。

en.t: and she happily recalled the scene from today, when she had gone with Masako to the village of Kitayama cedars.

units.source_text: 说也奇怪，真砂子所说的酷似她的那个姑娘的形象，

en.t: Strangely enough, the image of the girl Masako had spoken of, the one who looked exactly like her,

units.source_text: 远比那村庄的情景更清晰地浮现在她的记忆里。

en.t: came back to her memory far more clearly than the scene of that village.
